tunables.description: Top skating speed in metres per second. Higher is faster and harder to control.
How sharply skaters turn, in radians per second.
How fast the puck leaves the stick after a shot, in metres per second.
The fastest the puck can ever travel, in metres per second.
How slippery the ice is. 0 never slows down, 0.015 is real ice.
How bouncy the boards are. 0 is dead, 1 is a perfect bounce.
How fast the bots skate compared with you. 1 is equal.
How sharp the opposing bots are. 0 is clumsy, 1 is sharp.
How long the game pauses after a goal, in physics frames (60 per second).
